messages:
Maya Patel: just merged docs-only PR #4312, main pipeline flipped red in canary smoke, saw allocation failures
CI Bot: Build failed on main — https://ci.redwood/runs/98765 (smoke-canary)
CI Bot: Failing job: smoke-gpu/kvalloc-smoke (exit 137)
Liam O'Connor: grabbing logs now, can you paste the top error lines?
Maya Patel: logs snippet below:
```
[2026-03-18T13:12:05Z] Allocator: request 2.0GB failed, remaining 128MB
[2026-03-18T13:12:05Z] kvalloc-test: device allocation failed, status=OOM
[2026-03-18T13:12:06Z] killing process 3456 with SIGKILL
```
Samir Khan: that's an allocator OOM. Odd for a docs-only merge. Could be a noisy node or recent infra change.
Oncall Eng: I'm kicking a rerun on a fresh node (rerun id 98766)
CI Bot: Rerun requested by Oncall Eng — https://ci.redwood/runs/98766
Maya Patel: commit is abcdef1 (docs), if rerun passes i'll close, if not we should bisect quickly
Liam O'Connor: dont revert yet. waiting for rerun. also check kernel/driver patch rollouts in the last 6 hours.
Samir Khan: pinging eng-runtime: @eng-runtime any allocator/kernel changes rolled today that could hit canary GPU nodes?
eng-runtime: nothing user-facing rolled in the last 12h on allocator side, but there was a kernel packaging tweak on a subset of nodes two hours ago. investigating which nodes ran this job.
Oncall Eng: rerun started, logs streaming: https://ci.redwood/runs/98766/stream
CI Bot: Rerun result: FAILED (same job smoke-gpu/kvalloc-smoke) — failure at 00:03:48
Maya Patel: ugh. consistent failure. let's bisect range: last-green on main was commit 5f3b2a9 (6 commits ago), current HEAD is abcdef1
Liam O'Connor: agree. start bisection between 5f3b2a9..abcdef1, but since it's docs-only, suspect infra. however bisect will rule out unknowns.
Samir Khan: I'll run a targeted smoke on a pool that didn't get the kernel packaging tweak to see if it's infra-only. If that passes, we escalate to infra ops for rollback.
Oncall Eng: creating bisect job now and tagging infra-ops.
Maya Patel: thanks. if bisect points to infra, i'll hold any further merges.
eng-runtime: initial quick check: both failed runs landed on node pool gpu-canary-3 which did receive the packaging tweak. kicking a run on gpu-canary-1 (no tweak).
CI Bot: gpu-canary-1 targeted run started — https://ci.redwood/runs/98770
CI Bot: gpu-canary-1 run: PASSED (smoke-gpu/kvalloc-smoke)
Liam O'Connor: that strongly points to the packaging tweak on gpu-canary-3. Samir, please coordinate rollback or patch with infra-ops.
Samir Khan: on it, paging infra-ops and posting the node ids.
Oncall Eng: thanks all. I'll leave a note on the merge that we're holding new merges to main until infra confirms fix. :handshake:
Maya Patel: thanks for the quick eyeballs — will wait on the rollback confirmation before doing anything else. :thumbsup:
CI Bot: Incident note: marked as "canary infra regression" and assigned to infra-ops.
